data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the XP-Master.
data_description.port: Port of the Netroni API, normally 8765.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the XP-Master.

abort.not_netroni: The discovered device is not an XP-Master.

init.title: Tunable-white pairs
init.description: Pick the XP-Mini to configure. Use its Identify Ch buttons to find the fixtures if needed.

channels.title: Tunable-white pairs on {mini}
channels.description: Tick a channel to combine its A (warm white) and B (cool white) outputs into one tunable-white light. Untick it to split them back into two dimmable lights.

confirm.title: Change the lights of {mini}?

abort.not_loaded: The XP-Master is not connected. Try again when it is online.
abort.mini_gone: That XP-Mini is no longer part of this XP-Master.

pair_channel.name: Pair channel
pair_channel.description: Combines ChnA (warm) and ChnB (cool) of an XP-Mini into one tunable-white light. The two single lights are replaced and lose their names and areas.

unpair_channel.name: Unpair channel
unpair_channel.description: Splits an XP-Mini's Chn tunable-white light back into ChnA and ChnB. The tunable-white light is replaced and loses its name and area.
